{{Top|leg|title=k'Jtari martial art}}
The '''k'Jtari martial art''' was created by the [[K'Jtari/Legends|k'Jtari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The martial art was a form of brawling, which involved mental and physical components. [[Dunan Par'Ell]] was a practitioner of k'Jtari.
